paper_title: Function of CH2 Addends on 54π Fullerene Acceptors

knowledge_points.content: bis-OQMF is synthesized by reacting C60CH2 with 1,4-dihydrobenzo[d][1,2]oxathiine 3-oxide in ortho-dichlorobenzene (ODCB) at 100 °C for 22 hours, yielding 36% after silica gel column purification.
knowledge_points.evidence: To a solution of C60CH2 (1.0 g, 1.36 mmol) in ODCB 200 mL) was added 1,4-dihydrobenzo[d][1,2]oxathiine 3-oxide (928 mg, 5.52 mmol). The mixture was stirred at 100 °C for 22 h. ... The third band was collected to give bis-OQMF 457 mg, yield: 36%).

knowledge_points.content: The LUMO levels of the fullerene acceptors tris-OQC, bis-OQMF, and OQBMF are determined to be -3.29 eV, -3.37 eV, and -3.41 eV, respectively, based on cyclic voltammetry measurements.
knowledge_points.evidence: Table S1 Electrochemical data for tris-OQC, bis-OQMF and OQBMF. ... LUMO ' (eV) tris-OQC -3.29, bis-OQMF -3.37, OQBMF -3.41.

knowledge_points.content: The conventional organic solar cell architecture used for testing P3HT:fullerene blends consists of ITO/PEDOT:PSS (30 nm)/Active Layer (~110 nm)/Ca (10 nm)/Al (100 nm).
knowledge_points.evidence: A 30 nm thick poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene)-polystyrene sulfonate (PEDOT:PSS... layer was formed on ITO substrates... Ca (~10 nm) and Al (~100 nm) were thermally evaporated under a shadow mask successively.

knowledge_points.content: The active layer of P3HT:fullerene (1:0.6 weight ratio) is processed from an ortho-dichlorobenzene (ODCB) solution at a concentration of 24 mg/mL and subjected to thermal annealing at 140 °C for 10 minutes.
knowledge_points.evidence: A P3HT:fullerene (w/w, 1:0.6) blend in ODCB (24 mg/mL) was spin-coated onto PEDOT:PSS layer (1200 rpm for 60 s). Then the films were annealed at 140 °C for 10 min.

knowledge_points.content: Charge carrier mobility is calculated using the Space Charge Limited Current (SCLC) method by fitting the dark current density (J) to the Mott-Gurney law equation: J = 9/8 * ε0 * εr * μ * (V^2 / d^3).
knowledge_points.evidence: Charge carrier mobility was measured by SCLC method. The mobility was determined by fitting the dark current to the model of a single carrier SCLC, which is described by: J = 9/8 * ε0 * εr * μ * (V^2 / d^3)

knowledge_points.content: Electron-only devices for measuring electron mobility utilize an Al/active layer/Ca/Al structure, while hole-only devices utilize a Cr/Au/PEDOT:PSS/active layer/MoO3/Au structure.
knowledge_points.evidence: The structure for electron-only devices is Al/active layer/Ca/Al. ... The structure for hole-only devices is Cr/Au/PEDOT:PSS/active layer/MoO3/Au.

knowledge_points.content: Cyclic voltammetry was performed in a 9:1 ODCB/CH3CN solution using 0.1 M tetrabutylammonium hexafluorophosphate as the electrolyte and a glassy-carbon working electrode, with potentials corrected against the Fc/Fc+ redox couple.
knowledge_points.evidence: Measurements were performed in ODCB/CH3CN (9:1) solution containing tetrabutylammonium hexafluorophosphate (0.1 M) as a supporting electrolyte... All potentials were corrected against Fc/Fc+.

knowledge_points.content: The first reduction potentials (E1/2 Red1) for tris-OQC, bis-OQMF, and OQBMF were measured as -1.51 V, -1.43 V, and -1.39 V vs Fc/Fc+, respectively.
knowledge_points.evidence: Table S1 Electrochemical data for tris-OQC, bis-OQMF and OQBMF. ... Red1 a V E12: tris-OQC -1.51, bis-OQMF -1.43, OQBMF -1.39.

knowledge_points.content: High-resolution ESI mass spectrometry confirms the identity of bis-OQMF (C77H18) with a found [M+H]+ value of 943.1459, corresponding to a calculated value of 943.1481.
The built-in potential (Vbi) in SCLC measurements is determined by the electrode workfunction difference and is subtracted from the applied voltage (Vappl) to obtain the effective voltage (Veff).
knowledge_points.evidence: V is the effective voltage, V = Vappl - Vbi, where Vappl is the applied voltage, and Vbi is the built-in potential determined by electrode workfunction difference.

knowledge_points.content: Double-carrier devices, used to study recombination or dark current characteristics, were fabricated with the architecture Cr/Au/PEDOT:PSS/active layer/Ca/Al.
knowledge_points.evidence: The structure for double-carrier devices is Cr/Au/PEDOT:PSS/active layer/Ca/Al.

knowledge_points.content: The active layer thickness for electron-only, hole-only, and double-carrier devices used in mobility studies was maintained at approximately 135 nm.
knowledge_points.evidence: The thickness of the active layer (~135 nm) was measured by KLA Tencor D-120 profilometer. ... The thicknesses for all blend films are ~135 nm [for Figure S5].
